## Evidence and change

## Validation

- [ ] Proposal JSON matches its filename and assigned shelf.
- [ ] Located-only evidence has no invented payload hash.
- [ ] No source bodies, private paths, credentials or operational records included.
- [ ] Catalog, release hashes and generated indexes are unchanged for this proposal.
- [ ] `python -B checks.py` and standalone tests pass.

Maintainer acceptance, Core admission, score changes and publication are separate.
